## Copper Dragon, Young Adult (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
 CG Large dragon (earth)  
 **Init** +5; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +19  

**Defense**

 **AC** 26, touch 10, flat-footed 25 (+1 Dex, +16 natural, -1 size)  
 **hp** 136 (13d12+52)  
 **Fort** +12, **Ref** +9, **Will** +11  
 **Defensive Abilities** uncanny dodge; **DR** 5/magic; **Immune** acid, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 22  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor); climb stone  
 **Melee** bite +18 (2d6+9/19–20), 2 claws +18 (1d8+6/19–20), tail slap +13 (1d8+9), 2 wings +13 (1d6+3)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (80-ft. line, DC 20, 10d6 acid), slow breath  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 13th; concentration +16)  

  At will—*[grease](../../magic/spells/grease.md)* (DC 14), *[hideous laughter](../../magic/spells/hideous-laughter.md)* (DC 15)  

 **Sorcerer Spells Known** (CL 5th; concentration +8)  

  2nd (5/day)—*[invisibility](../../magic/spells/invisibility.md)*, *[phantom trap](../../magic/spells/phantom-trap.md)*  
 1st (7/day)—*[alarm](../../magic/spells/alarm.md)*, *[magic missile](../../magic/spells/magic-missile.md)*, *[shield](../../magic/spells/shield.md)*, *[silent image* ](../../magic/spells/silent-image.md)(DC 14)  
 0 (at will)—*[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[ghost sound* ](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)(DC 13), *light, [message](../../magic/spells/message.md)*, *[prestidigitation](../../magic/spells/prestidigitation.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 23, **Dex** 12, **Con** 19, **Int** 16, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 16  
 **Base Atk** +13; **CMB** +20 (+24 trip); **CMD** 31 (37 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Combat Expertise, Greater Trip, Improved Critical (bite, claw), Improved Initiative, Improved Trip, Power Attack  
 **Skills** Bluff +19, Craft (traps) +24, Diplomacy +19, Fly +11, Perception +19 (+24 vs. traps), Perform (comedy) +16, Sense Motive +19, Stealth +13, Use Magic Device +19  
 **Languages** Common, Draconic, Gnome, Halfling  
 **SQ** trap master  

**Special Abilities**

 **Climb Stone (Ex)** A copper dragon can climb on stone surfaces as though using the *spider climb* spell.  

 **Slow Breath (Su)** Instead of a line of acid, a copper dragon can breathe a cone of slowing gas. Those in the cone must make a Fortitude save or be slowed (as per the spell *slow*) for 1d6 rounds plus 1 round per age category of the dragon.  

 **Trap Master (Ex)** A juvenile or older copper dragon receives a +1 bonus per age categroy on Craft (traps) and Perception checks made to locate a trap. Upon becoming a mature adult, he can also use Disable Device to disarm magic traps as if he had the rogue’s Trapfinding class feature.

**Ecology**

Environment
